briefings.title: Lindon Gao: Finding Clarity in the Fog of Robotics, Disagreements & Choices, and Wang Yangming
briefings.tldr: Lindon Gao, serial entrepreneur and founder of Dyna Robotics, advocates a "product research" approach to robotics—leveraging real-world workflows as closed-loop testing units to drive foundational egocentric data pre-training and scaling.

briefings.title: Zeng Ming: The Brutal Truth, Companies That Will Disappear, Why “Excellent” ≠ “Great”

people.name: Zeng Ming
people.role: Professor and former Chief of Staff, Alibaba Group

briefings.tldr: Professor Zeng Ming argues that the AI era represents a paradigm shift surpassing the Industrial Revolution, predicting that traditional hierarchical companies will die out and be replaced by task-centric, partnership-driven AI-native organizations.

briefings.title: Anker / Steven Yang: Consumer Electronics Death & birth, The Third Category,  Product Philosophy
briefings.tldr: Steven Yang outlines Anker’s transition from a "simple product" company to a "Third Category" organization, focusing on building long-term moats through localized AI, embodied intelligence, and a culture of first-principles thinking.

briefings.title: He Xiaopeng: Robot IRON's Birth, The Accident, GX, His Big Bet & Swimming in Blood
briefings.tldr: XPeng is undergoing a fundamental pivot from an "AI car company" to a "Physical AI group," abandoning traditional software-heavy architectures for a massive bet on end-to-end foundation models (VLA) and committing to humanoid robotics—a field He Xiaopeng estimates is 20 to 100 times more difficult than automotive manufacturing.

briefings.title: 141. Freda的投资札记第2集：Tokenmaxxing、把电机塞进蒸汽机、接力赛变篮球赛、孤独、人的连接
briefings.tldr: The AI industry is transitioning from a period of "Tokenmaxxing" waste to an efficiency-driven era where "better AI builds better AI," shifting business models from per-unit token costs to outcome-based value.

briefings.title: A 4-hour Interview with Carina Hong: AI for Math, Lean, Proofs from The Book, and Intuition
briefings.tldr: Carina Hong Letong, the 24-year-old founder of Axiom, is leading a "Neo Lab" that utilizes formal proof languages like Lean to achieve superhuman mathematical performance, including the first AI-driven perfect score in the history of the Putnam Competition.

briefings.title: A 7-hour marathon interview with Saining Xie: World Models, AMI Labs, Yann LeCun, Fei-Fei Li, and 42
briefings.tldr: Saining Xie and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun have launched AMI Labs with a record-breaking $1.03B seed round to pivot from "LLM-pilled" language modeling toward "World Models"—autonomous systems capable of predictive reasoning and physical understanding rather than mere pattern matching.

briefings.title: Kimi Founder Yang Zhilin: K2, Agentic LLMs, Brains in Vats, and the Beginning of Infinity
briefings.tldr: Kimi founder Yang Zhilin reflects on two years of AI entrepreneurship following the release of Kimi K2, noting that while the industry faces persistent "data walls" and evaluation challenges, the pursuit of scaling through test-time compute, Muon optimizers, and generalist Agentic systems continues to drive the relentless climb toward Artificial General Intelligence (AGI).
